messages:
marie: Heads-up — customers on Standard tier are hitting fallbacks to cheap-variant more than expected. Can we surface per-tenant fallback counts and token-cost impact in the Console?

dan: +1. We only show global fallback rate right now. Per-tenant would help ops and sales triage cost regressions.

aseem: We should also add a fast-to-parse metric in telemetry: `fallback_tokens` and `fallback_calls`. That lets billing compute delta vs. preferred model.

olivia: For UX, proposal: add a small ‘Fallbacks’ column on the Customer Usage table with a two-line tooltip: count + estimated token-cost saved/lost. Keep it collapsible.

marie: Agreed. Also want an alerting rule: alert when fallback rate > 10% AND p95 latency on cheap-variant > baseline p95 * 1.5. That catches bad fallbacks.

dan: Implementation notes: routing layer already tags requests with `route_variant` and `fallback_reason`. We need a light-weight aggregator to roll up per-tenant daily counts. Could be a kstream job that writes to metrics-store.

aseem: Draft event schema suggestion:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "str",
  "timestamp": "iso",
  "route_variant": "string",
  "preferred_model": "string",
  "actual_model": "string",
  "tokens": "int",
  "fallback_reason": "enum"
}
```
This is tiny and lets downstream join with pricing SKU.

olivia: UX question — where do we show config for who gets fallbacks? Product says avoid making it too easy for customers to opt-into cheaper variants (sales concerns). So Console should be read-only by default, with a request flow to enable per-tenant cheap routing.

marie: Makes sense. We also need admin controls for auto-throttle: e.g., per-tenant `cheap_variant_budget` measured in tokens/day with soft and hard caps. If soft cap exceeded, fallback probability drops to 10%. If hard cap reached, block cheap-variant entirely.

dan: Sounds like a policy engine feature. We can express it as a small DSL in the routing config: `budget_tokens: 100000`, `soft_threshold_pct: 0.8`, `soft_fallback_prob: 0.1`, `hard_action: deny`.

aseem: On telemetry side, please emit both `budget_usage_pct` and `budget_state` labels so console graph can color by state (ok, soft, hard).

marie: For rollout safety, can we run a 2-week experiment where new rule only applies to <=5% of traffic for Standard tier and all of Background workloads? Split routing key by `workload_type`.

rollout-bot: canary: routing-policy:v3 -> 5% traffic (start 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC) :rocket:

olivia: Also add a one-click drilldown from a tenant row to see 7-day fallback timelines and top failing prompts. That will speed support.

dan: I'll spike the kstream aggregator and a small metrics endpoint `/v1/internal/tenant_fallbacks?tenant_id=...`. We can gate it behind beta flag.

marie: Thanks — priority: high. Need per-tenant telemetry and Console surface before end of next sprint so sales has data for upcoming renewals.

aseem: I'll add the schema PR and a prometheus-exporter shim.

olivia: I'll mock the Console panel and link it in the product spec doc.

marie: Sweet. Follow-ups: (1) dan to post rough data volume estimate, (2) aseem to PR event schema, (3) olivia to attach mock. :thumbsup:

dan: will do.

rollout-bot: deployment: canary routing-policy:v3 completed on 5% -> monitor `fallback_rate` and `cheap_variant_latency` for next 72h.
